Muted earthy colour palette: grey concrete (#8C8D8A), dusty brown (#8D775F), olive green (#5F6B4E), and mustard yellow (#D4A017). Soft cinematic lighting, gentle cel shading, subtle paper-like texture. Detailed illustrated environment, borderless edge-to-edge full canvas composition.
prompt_injection.character_anchor: The Wanderer, original 2D stickman protagonist with oversized warm ivory oval head, two small vertical black pill eyes, neutral slit mouth. Wearing a chunky brick-red ribbed knit beanie, a thick winter scarf with alternating horizontal mustard-yellow and rust-maroon stripes with fringe, dark charcoal short-sleeved t-shirt, and thin solid black stick limbs.
